_note: How Nyxie wakes (hunters/gimmicks/nyxie.rs). Godot game/config/game_config.gd: NYXIE_TIMER_DELAY 120, NYXIE_EMPTY_DELAY 10, NYXIE_DESPAWN_RANGE 7, NYXIE_DISPEL_HALF_ANGLE 0.33, NYXIE_SPAWN_DISTANCE 10. dead_delay and dead_spawn_distance are ours (owner request): once the flashlight is dead (charge empty, the lamp cannot light) she appears after dead_delay seconds, dead_spawn_distance cells from the runner, instead of waiting timer_delay. A live beam within despawn_range sends her back, as for the timer wake. A lamp that stays dead until empty_delay still ends in the inescapable catch. dead_delay must not exceed empty_delay. The wake is the same on every difficulty.
